title: Compress the Easy, Explore the Hard: Difficulty-Aware Entropy Regularization for Efficient LLM Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical methodologies for optimizing Reinforcement Learning in LLMs to achieve reasoning compression. Its evaluation is strictly based on mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks such as GSM8K, MATH500, and AIME, with no components related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
